title: Home Oxygen Therapy Claims Note: First Day of Service When a New Primary Coverage Starts Mid-Month
content:
# First Day of Service Under a New Primary Coverage — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Rule.** When a different coverage becomes primary for Home Oxygen Therapy, the first day of service it covers is found from the oxygen claim history of the earlier coverage (the coverage the oxygen record names) and the new coverage's effective date on the coverage record:

1. when the effective date falls inside the last month the earlier coverage paid on the oxygen claim history — that month began before the effective date and less than one whole calendar month before it — and the earlier coverage denied a later month as coverage inactive, the first day of service is the first day of the most recent month it denied as coverage inactive;
2. when the last month the earlier coverage paid began on or after the effective date, the first day of service is the first day of that paid month;
3. otherwise it is the effective date.

The paid months read are the paid equipment months and paid contents months of the earlier coverage on the oxygen claim history; the denials read are its months denied as coverage inactive.

## Input — judgement — output

| Last month the earlier coverage paid | Later month denied as coverage inactive | First day of service |
|---|---|---|
| began before the effective date, less than one whole calendar month before it | yes | first day of the most recent coverage-inactive month |
| began before the effective date, less than one whole calendar month before it | no | the effective date |
| began on or after the effective date | either | first day of that paid month |
| began one whole calendar month or more before the effective date | either | the effective date |
| no paid month on the claim history | — | the effective date |

## Cases (hypothetical dates, effective date 20 March)

- Last paid month began 5 March; the month beginning 5 April was denied as coverage inactive. The effective date falls inside the March month: the first day of service is 5 April.
- Last paid month began 5 April, on or after 20 March: the first day of service is 5 April.
- Last paid month began 5 February, more than one whole month before 20 March: the first day of service is 20 March.
